The activity requests "safety performance metrics across all reported events" - this is asking for aggregated safety analytics/reporting data. While some candidates have safety-adjacent capabilities (like the Employee Hierarchy API's "identify-role-based-hazards" and the Compensation API's "calculate-hazard-pay"), none of them actually expose safety performance metrics or event reporting data. The candidates are all focused on production changes, material provisioning, workforce readiness, and compliance validation - not on pulling together safety event metrics or performance dashboards. A meaningful match would be a safety management system, incident reporting API, or safety analytics data product, none of which appear in this candidate list.
